data.long_meaning: Naifah is a beautiful and elegant name of Arabic origin. It is derived from the Arabic word 'nafa' which means 'to be light' or 'graceful'. The name signifies a delicate and refined character, one who moves with grace and poise. It is also a name with deep spiritual significance in Islam, representing the gentle and compassionate nature of Allah.
